sequenceReference.note: Roadmap v1 P04, first serial subpackage: the one immutable, inert PolicyStatement policy-as-data row. Record-set behavior, condition semantics, matching, candidate derivation, ordering and deny-overrides execution are deferred to P04b.

scopeSynthesis.note: Blind MASTER/Claude scope synthesis, independently accepted. Historical unmerged PolicyStatement commits are design archaeology only; this package's bytes are newly authored on this immutable base, never copied or laundered from them.

goal: Add PolicyStatement, an immutable value carrying exactly the ten fields of one declarative policy row: id, effect, targetActor, targetAction, targetResourceType, condition, priority, layer, version, enabled. effect is exactly allow|deny; layer is exactly system|platform|tenant; priority is a safe integer; enabled is a primitive boolean; version is an exact SemVer 2.0.0 string retained verbatim; id/targetAction/targetResourceType are bounded canonical lowercase scalars; targetActor and condition are defensive, deterministic, deeply frozen JSON-data values that fail closed on cycles, shared references, holes, accessors, symbols, hostile keys, non-finite numbers and exotic prototypes. Deterministic toJSON/toString/equals; no clock, random, environment, filesystem or network effect. It is inert: it never matches, combines, derives a candidate, batches or logs a decision.
nonGoals: no matcher, wildcard or condition evaluation
no candidate resolver or candidatesFor derivation
no combining algorithm or deny-overrides execution
no decision-log entry, hash-chain or append port (P04d)
no persistence, migration or RLS adapter (P04e)
no PEP, HTTP or UI surface
no change to Policy, PolicyRequest, PolicyDecision, AuthorizationEvaluator, PolicyDecisionPoint or the CreateCustomer pipeline
no P05, P07, CI/config, version bump, release, deploy or readiness-marker change

scopeResolution.note: PolicyStatement is a standalone value class in src/application/policy-statement.mjs with zero imports. It follows the exactOptions/exact-class/deep-freeze conventions already established by src/application/policy-decision.mjs and src/application/action-contract.mjs in this ring: an ordinary Object.prototype options object carrying exactly the ten declared own enumerable data properties (checked by descriptor, never invoked); a captured canonicalRoot/canonicalValue routine (mirroring policy-decision.mjs's PolicyRequest resource/context hardening) governs targetActor and condition; bounded regex-checked scalars govern id, targetAction, targetResourceType, effect, layer and version; priority and enabled are checked by primitive type. toJSON()/toString() render the fixed ten-key declared order; equals() is exact-class and structural over that rendering.
